description: Which places does a postal code / ZIP code / postcode / PIN code / PLZ / CEP cover, and which state, province, county or district are they in? Returns every place name for the code with its first-, second- and third-level administrative units and coordinates. 124 countries (GeoNames). Accepts common input forms (e.g. "SW1A 1AA" maps to the outward code SW1A, "K1A 0B1" to K1A, ZIP+4 to the 5-digit ZIP, "1000001" to JP 100-0001).

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (AU, US, GB, DE, IN, PH, ...) or an English country name.

postal_code.description: The postal code as written locally, e.g. 3220, 90210, 10115, 560001, SW1A 1AA, 100-0001.

name: lookup_postal_code
title: Look up a postal code
